summary: Vertigo is Banyan Tree Bangkok’s open-air rooftop grill and Moon Bar is its adjoining open-air cocktail bar, both on the 61st floor with broad city views. The hotel currently lists both as closed for renovation and reopening 2 December 2026.
whyGo: A dramatic, elevated view over Sathorn and Bangkok, paired with dinner or sunset cocktails.
Choose between a full Pacific Rim grill meal at Vertigo and drinks at Moon Bar.
bestFor: A special-occasion dinner or skyline cocktail in polished hotel surroundings.
Visitors who value the rooftop setting and are comfortable with premium hotel-bar prices.
skipIf: You need a confirmed operating schedule before making plans: reopening is announced, but post-renovation hours and reservation availability are not yet published.
You prefer casual prices, dislike heights, or need a sheltered venue; both spaces are open air.
duration: Allow about 1–2 hours for drinks, or 2–3 hours for dinner; planning estimates, not published visit durations.
cost: Premium. The currently linked official menu lists cocktails around THB 490–590 each and notes prices are subject to 10% service charge and applicable tax; food and post-renovation prices may change. Budget roughly THB 700–900+ per cocktail after charges, before any extra drinks or food (estimate).
hours: Reopening is announced for 2 December 2026. The hotel has not yet confirmed the new Vertigo or Moon Bar daily hours; check directly before visiting. Older third-party listings may describe pre-renovation hours.
bestTime: Aim for sunset into early evening for the changing light and illuminated skyline, subject to the venue’s post-reopening hours and weather. Reserve a little daylight for the view.
gettingThere: At Banyan Tree Bangkok, 21/100 South Sathorn Road, Sathorn. The hotel identifies Lumphini MRT (Blue Line, Exit 2 to South Sathorn Road) and Sala Daeng BTS (Silom Line) as nearby stations; neither has a direct station connection to the hotel. Allow for a walk or use a taxi; hotel concierge can advise on the route. Rooftop access is within the hotel, but exact lift and step-free arrangements are not specified online.
booking: The official Vertigo page directs guests to contact the team for reopening enquiries and reservation information. Call +66 2 679 1200 or email Hostesses-bangkok@banyantree.com; confirm that December 2026 reservations are being accepted and whether Moon Bar visits require a booking.
accessibility: The rooftop is on floor 61 of a hotel tower, but the official venue page does not explain lift access, step-free circulation, accessible toilets, or seating arrangements. Contact the hotel with specific mobility needs before booking. Open-air exposure also means wind and rain may affect comfort or service.
practicalTips: The hotel describes its rooftop restaurants as smart casual; wear neat evening clothes and confirm any detailed restrictions with the venue.
Ask for a table or bar seating preference when booking; requests may depend on availability.
Check weather and reopening status on the day, and have a covered alternative in mind for rain or strong wind.
Menu prices shown online are subject to a 10% service charge and applicable tax.
decemberNotes: The announced reopening date, 2 December 2026, places it just before the December high season. Hours, the refreshed experience, menus, prices and booking arrangements could change during reopening; reconfirm directly, especially for dates near opening and holiday evenings. No December 2026 rooftop event schedule was found.
uncertainties: Post-renovation hours and whether both venues will operate every day are not published as of 17 October 2026.
The linked menu is current online but may be revised for the reopening; quoted cocktail prices are indicative only.
Official pages do not detail accessibility features or exact dress-code exclusions for this venue.
The selected official photograph is a Banyan Tree Bangkok venue reference; reuse permission is not established.
